name: opt3.k
model:
class OptTest3 {
  energy:Int
  speed:Int

  req energy >= 0

  req energy <= 100

  req speed >= 0

  req speed <= 100

  req energy + speed <= 120
  minimize energy weight 1
  maximize speed weight 2
}

main:OptTest3
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (main Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((OptTest3 (mk-OptTest3 (energy Int)(speed Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-OptTest3 (sel-OptTest3 OptTest3))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-OptTest3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-OptTest3 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-OptTest3 ((this Ref)) OptTest3
  (sel-OptTest3 (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-OptTest3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-OptTest3 this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.main: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!main ((this Ref)) Ref
  (main (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; -------------------------------
;   Getters for class OptTest3:
; -------------------------------

; --- getters for OptTest3.energy: ---

(define-fun OptTest3!energy ((this Ref)) Int
  (energy (deref-OptTest3 this))
)

; --- getters for OptTest3.speed: ---

(define-fun OptTest3!speed ((this Ref)) Int
  (speed (deref-OptTest3 this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-OptTest3 (TopLevelDeclarations!main this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ---------------------------------
;   Invariant for class OptTest3:
; ---------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-OptTest3 OptTest3)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun OptTest3.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptTest3!energy this) 0)
)

(assert (! (OptTest3.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun OptTest3.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OptTest3!energy this) 100)
)

(assert (! (OptTest3.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun OptTest3.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (OptTest3!speed this) 0)
)

(assert (! (OptTest3.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun OptTest3.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (OptTest3!speed this) 100)
)

(assert (! (OptTest3.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun OptTest3.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (+ (OptTest3!energy this) (OptTest3!speed this)) 120)
)

(assert (! (OptTest3.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Optimization Objectives (informational): ---

; (minimize (OptTest3!energy this) :weight 1)
; (maximize (OptTest3!speed this) :weight 2)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-OptTest3 const-1-OptTest3))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-OptTest3 () OptTest3
  (mk-OptTest3 0 43))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (<= (energy (sel-OptTest3 (select heap 1))) 100))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (>= (speed (sel-OptTest3 (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (energy (sel-OptTest3 (select heap 1)))
              (speed (sel-OptTest3 (select heap 1))))))
  (<= a!1 120)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (main (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-OptTest3 a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (>= (energy (sel-OptTest3 (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (<= (speed (sel-OptTest3 (select heap 1))) 100))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-OptTest3 (mk-OptTest3 0 43))))
